text: The purpose of this report is to advise the Executive Committee the establishment of a fee of $20.00 for the new Criminal Record and Judicial Matters Checks for the purpose of employment and volunteer opportunities.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the establishment of a fee of $20.00 for the new Criminal Record and Judicial Matters Checks for the purpose of employment and volunteer opportunities, effective November 1, 2018.
